reply_text:
I'll push to your fork as its own branch. Your fork's `main` is behind and doesn't contain this work, so I won't touch it. First a check for host paths:Pushed to your fork as branch **`kernel-m1`**: https://github.com/tothedarktowercame/mfuton-share/tree/kernel-m1

It's 90 commits on top of Rob's current `main`:
- **M1:** the olean reader, `IO.Error` construction through Lean's exports, filesystem functions with libuv errors, `profileit`, `evalConst`/`runModInitCore`, heartbeats, and the import demo with the Lean driver;
- **the kernel lanes' merged work so far:** expression primitives, early type checker, environment insertion, `Quot`, mutual definitions, inductive types slice 1, and extern batches;
- **the scalar-layout fix and the two acceptance-test harnesses.**

One host path, in codex-58's extern-scanner tool, was removed before pushing. It now reads `LEAN_SOURCE` from the environment.

Rob's repo is untouched. I'll push to his `main` when M2 lands, with a note on #5.
